checks.requirement_quote: 设计一个会议室预约占用提示系统，使用 PIR 人体红外 D2、门磁 D3、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED 绿色 D12、红色 D13、蜂鸣器 D6 和串口。串口可输入预约开始和结束时间；到预约开始前 1 分钟闪烁绿灯提醒，有人进入后显示 occupied 并点亮红灯；预约结束后若仍有人在内则蜂鸣提示并输出 overtime use。按钮 D7 用于人工释放房间。

plan.coverage_explanation: Executed exploratory core scenario with explicitly disclosed interface uncertainty.
assumptions: Raw stated TM1637 D4/D5 wiring is retained. Several original questions assign that same pin to another device; no silent rewiring is performed.
These scenarios cover explicit observable core paths; unspecified thresholds, configuration UI and command grammar prevent complete conformance coverage.
The undisclosed reservation grammar is exercised as two whitespace-delimited minute values, start=1 and end=2; parser incompatibility is an interface uncertainty, not alone proof of semantic failure.
